expected.subject: dev.product_feedback/prepared-evaluation-2026-09-07
expected.value: Agent-customer finding from prepared evaluation batch 4: eliminating duplicate same-call evaluation provides a measured submit improvement, but the whole authoring loop remains too slow to treat latency as finished. The safe reusable unit is a sealed computation plus complete input/observation bindings, not an SDK certificate or a new authority cache. Fresh mutable observations remain necessary, and unversioned operational evidence must fall back rather than pretending to be stable. The instance-owned registry centralizes lifecycle while call-local retention avoids persistent cache growth. World-sized receive validation, card stripping and Git publication remain architectural scope problems; spend the next optimization effort on verified delta interfaces instead of proliferating caches. This is a sourced manager assessment of local code and measurements, not deployed state.
